summary: Probably John's 4th-great-grand-uncle; husband of Huldah Ives.
bio:
Inferred son of Samuel and Martha: the widow Hulda (Ives) Pringle's children were named Orange, Ransom and Keturah - Lamoreaux family names - making her husband very probably a Samuel Jr. No record names him directly.

Round 4 found him on a record. The 1840 census of Plymouth Twp has a 'Saml Pringle' household headed by a man aged 30-40 with a wife aged 30-40 and nine children ([R4-S1]). It sits next door to James Pringle and two doors from Joseph Ives. The elder Samuel would have been in his seventies, so this is the younger man, and the Ives neighbour fits his wife Hulda Ives. FamilySearch has him as 'Samuel David Pringle', born 1794, married to Hulda Ives (1804-1886) in 1824 at Plymouth, and attaches the 1830 and 1840 censuses ([R4-S2]). The 1840 age bracket points to a birth in 1800-1810, not 1794. FamilySearch gives him the same death date, 25 Mar 1847, as his father Samuel Sr., which suggests one profile has copied the other. He is buried at Shawnee Cemetery according to FamilySearch.
